description: Centers for Disease Control: Climate and Health Program is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. Access information related to climate and health from the U.S. Centers for Disease Control. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Air Quality, Extreme Heat, Flooding – General, Vector-Borne Disease, Water Quality. Assets: People. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
